summaries.public: The accepted tradition credits Calan’thir and Asmodeus with jointly creating the Crucible as a proving ground and a monument of Order and Hell working together. Cultures dispute their shares of the credit. Adventurers enter a dungeon that has shaped Aethel’s fortunes, beliefs and conflicts over generations.
summaries.director: Calan’thir and Asmodeus genuinely built the known Crucible around machinery they did not invent. The Silent Ones—also called the Old Ones—built the older Heartcell, including the hundred-floor resonance structure, ten Gate divisions, opening cycle and reward architecture. Owner-locked material also says its creators used loot as bait to invite discovery and release, while the Heartcell’s current operation generates the resonance and continuing difference that oppose Oblivion. The supplied sources do not yet establish why the Old Ones originally built a machine with these properties, how it became their prison, or the exact sequence by which the Divine Pact discovered, claimed, modified, activated and bound itself to it. Preserve those missing links as unresolved. The complete two-layer account is discoverable only through the recorded revelation ladder and is never ordinary world knowledge.
summaries.originScope: The surviving original books contain accounts of Great Stillness, contrary gestures, the Weave, Spiral, seals, the Sundering and the Pact. Their preservation does not make every passage authoritative. Use the registered domains and recorded owner decisions for the questions they actually settle; retain unresolved event relations rather than inventing a unified chronology.
summaries.peaceScope: Ordinary political peace, treaty, ceasefire or reconciliation is not the defined catastrophe. The threatened state is absolute ontological stillness: the loss of meaningful difference, possibility, motion and agency until existence no longer remains distinct. No measurable awakening threshold is established by this comparison; define one later only if mechanics actually require it.

issues.disposition: OWNER-LOCKED TWO-LAYER TRUTH; ORIGINAL LITERAL AUTHORSHIP CLAIMS SUPERSEDED IN PART
classification: bounded source contradiction resolved by Q3
issues.decision: Q3 controls. Calan'thir and Asmodeus are genuine joint builders of the public Crucible/Calan'thir's Trial, but the Silent Ones/Old Ones built the older Heartcell machinery. The custodians discovered, claimed, modified, activated and bound themselves to that pre-existing machine. Original passages that make Calan'thir/Asmodeus inventors of the entire underlying dungeon cannot be used literally as current objective authorship.

issues.disposition: Q5 CONTROLS REGISTER; COMPATIBLE METAPHOR MAY BE PRESERVED, LITERAL PRIMORDIAL-BEING CLAIMS ARE NOT OBJECTIVE CANON
issues.decision: Lumina/Umbra remain theological abstractions/mortal religious language under Q5. Cosmology P4 is compatible because it describes contrary gestures without shape, limb or mind and says later viewers supplied the names. Matrix P12 is compatible when read as principles manifesting will. Neither passage promotes an independently existing primordial deity ontology; unowned surrounding origin details remain source proposals rather than automatically authoritative facts.

issues.consequence: Do not reconcile Lumina/Umbra into literal First Choir members, Old Ones, or separately objective primordial gods.

issues.disposition: PARTIALLY COMPATIBLE ACCOUNTS; EXACT EVENT MAPPING AND “TWENTY CYCLES” REMAIN UNRESOLVED
issues.decision: The longer Cosmology account can overlap the Matrix summary: Asmodeus's assault strains the Spiral (P39), the Old Ones/Ul'nak emerge during the conflict (P49), and Calan'thir, the seven Choir voices and Asmodeus combine to reseal the threat (P50–53). Matrix P23–34 instead frames the Sundering around Old Ones imposing equality and states it lasted twenty cycles. No current owner lock defines whether 'Sundering' names the whole multi-stage crisis, only the Old-One phase, or another interval; nor is 'twenty cosmic cycles' mapped to mortal or opening-cycle time.

support.path: The Decennium Descent and the Matrix of Oblivion.docx

issues.consequence: Do not invent two dated wars, collapse them into one precisely bounded event, or convert twenty cycles into Decennium openings/years.

issues.topic: First Seal, Divine Pact and later public Crucible
issues.disposition: AUTHORSHIP CONTRADICTION RESOLVED BY Q3; SEAL/PACT CHRONOLOGY REMAINS OPEN
issues.decision: Q2 fixes 'the Pact' as the Divine Pact. Q3 fixes the custodial relationship to the pre-existing Heartcell. Therefore Matrix P48 ('The Divine Pact created the dungeon') and Cosmology P18 when read as invention of the entire underlying machine conflict with the later owner lock and are superseded in that literal sense. The supplied sources do not establish that every use of First Seal, compact, binding, Divine Pact, formal pact, Crucible construction, Heartcell activation and later governance was one event—or separate events. Cosmology P58 says a first divine pact formed 'in idea' with formal sentience later.

support.path: The Decennium Descent and the Matrix of Oblivion.docx

issues.consequence: Current summaries may say the Divine Pact governs/binds/modifies/activates the Heartcell, but must not invent a repaired event sequence.

issues.topic: Old Ones origin, motive and their own machinery
issues.disposition: REAL UNRESOLVED MOTIVE/PROVENANCE TENSION; DO NOT REPAIR
issues.decision: Q1 makes Silent Ones and Old Ones identical. Q3 says they built the Heartcell and used treasure as bait so mortals would discover and release them, while the same machine's present operation generates resonance/difference that keeps Oblivion at bay. Cosmology and Matrix characterize the Old Ones as seeking return to silence/elimination of difference. No supplied authority explains why they originally built this machinery, how it became their prison, what portions were later repurposed, or why a release-seeking design also functions as a counter-equation.

support.path: The Decennium Descent and the Matrix of Oblivion.docx

issues.consequence: State the locked facts side by side, but preserve the original construction motive/transformation path as unresolved.

issues.topic: First Choir emergence and exact seven
issues.disposition: EXACT SEVEN IS OWNER-LOCKED; EMERGENCE/AWAKENING TIMING IS COMPATIBLE BUT NOT PRECISELY FIXED
issues.decision: Q5 preserves the First Choir as exactly seven and distinct from the Fifteenfold mortal pantheon. Cosmology P27 presents seven nascent chords before the later battle; P38 shows the Choir acting as seven virtues; Matrix P27 says the First Choir awakened during the Sundering. These can coexist if 'awakened' means becoming fully active/manifest in the crisis, but that is an interpretive possibility, not a newly established chronology.

support.path: The Decennium Descent and the Matrix of Oblivion.docx

issues.consequence: Seven-member count/distinction may be used; exact maturation/awakening date remains non-authoritative.

issues.disposition: OWNER-LOCKED AUDIENCE DIFFERENCE; PROPOSED PUBLIC SUMMARY ACCEPTABLE WITH NO HEARTCELL LEAK
issues.decision: Q3 and PLAYER_DIRECTOR_BOUNDARY establish a genuine public explanation plus a four-stage revelation ladder. Public material may credit Calan'thir and Asmodeus with building/establishing the Crucible and describe its social importance. Heartcell authorship, Old Ones identity, bait intent, resonance-preservation purpose and the complete Matrix remain Director truth until discovered. Revelation deepens rather than invalidates the public myth.

issues.consequence: Do not use Director-origin mechanics in a public creation primer merely because they are true.

issues.disposition: KEEP SOURCE DISTINCTION; NO NUMERIC OR POLITICAL TRIGGER
issues.decision: Matrix P4–8 expressly distinguishes the dangerous state from political peace or reconciliation. The threatened condition is ontological stillness/elimination of meaningful difference, motion, choice and continued existence. The original Cosmology likewise frames the threat as hush/stillness and preserved difference. No supplied owner lock defines a numeric resonance threshold or makes a treaty, ceasefire, forgiveness or ordinary peace automatically catastrophic.

support.path: The Decennium Descent and the Matrix of Oblivion.docx

issues.consequence: Operational threshold remains future work only if mechanics actually require it; no owner question is required now.

issues.disposition: DEFER TO ORDERED LATER PASSES; RECORD SPECIFIC DEPENDENCIES
issues.decision: Do not resolve plane hierarchy, infernal lord roster, Shardspire origin, World Sections I–VI, Level-97 Old God/Binding/Interstice identity, later history, soul/afterlife doctrine, or public campaign-revelation implementation in this pass. Cosmology P56 contains an internal infernal-roster conflict by placing Mephistopheles in both Maladomini and Cania. World P1 explicitly omits Sections I–VI, so those missing bytes cannot be reconstructed from surviving VII+ prose.
issues.consequence: Flag and carry forward; do not improvise replacements.
